repos_data.description: Idiomatic Go SDK for the Bitget Unified Trading Account (UTA) API v3. Lightweight, dependency-minimal client with context.Context, typed REST models, string-based prices/quantities to avoid float rounding, plus reconnecting WebSocket with auto-resubscription. Built for safe and reliable crypto trading automation.

⚡ Professional Golang SDK for Bybit V5 API. Lightning-fast trading with real-time WebSocket streams, complete REST API coverage, and production-ready features. Supports spot & derivatives trading, HMAC/RSA authentication, multi-region endpoints, and advanced order types with TP/SL. Goroutine-safe, testnet-ready, zero dependencies. 🚀

Go client for OKX v5 API. 335 REST endpoints, 53 WebSocket channels. Type-safe models with generics, context support, auto-reconnect, demo trading mode. Covers trading, market data, account management, funding. Minimal dependencies (stdlib + gorilla/websocket). Thread-safe, production-ready. Go 1.21+

Zero-dependency Go client for the Coinglass API v4. Typed access to Futures, Spot, Options, ETF, and Indicator endpoints, with context support, safe concurrency, automatic retry with exponential backoff on rate limits, sentinel errors, and functional-option configuration. Built on the standard library and fully tested.

Full-featured Golang SDK for BingX cryptocurrency exchange API. Supports USDT-M & Coin-M perpetual futures, spot trading, market data, WebSocket streams, account management, and copy trading. Type-safe, production-ready with HMAC-SHA256 security. Complete API coverage with idiomatic Go interfaces.

Lightweight Go SDK for Telegram Wallet Pay. Integrate crypto payments (TON, USDT, BTC, NOT) into Telegram bots effortlessly. Includes secure HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, middleware for net/http, Gin, and Echo. Zero dependencies for core client, typed error handling, and full test coverage. MIT licensed
Official Python SDK for the SiftingIO market data API, sync and async REST clients plus a live WebSocket, fully type-hinted.
Cryptocurrency exchange API client for Julia
Complete, dependency-free Go client for the YNAB API — 44 operations, exact integer money, first-class delta sync, contract-tested. Unofficial.
C#/.NET client library for the Binance.com cryptocurrency exchange REST and WebSocket APIs, supporting Spot and Futures trading and market data with strongly typed models.
A production-ready Go SDK for TRON: gRPC client with connection pooling, HD wallets, TRC-10/TRC-20, event decoding, transaction simulation, and shielded TRC-20 (Sapling) support. 85% test coverage.

repo_meta_data.description: Idiomatic Go SDK for KuCoin REST & WebSocket APIs — UTA (Unified Trading Account) and Classic (Spot, Margin, Futures). Hand-written, not generated. String-typed prices, HMAC-SHA256 auth, context-aware methods, typed error hierarchy, conservative retry policy, injectable HTTP client, and manifest-driven endpoint documentation.
